hook: A three-story building of 1926 divided into six condominium units.

narrative.lead: 2856 Scott Street is a three-story building of 1926 divided into six condominium units, each its own parcel — lots 034 through 039 on block 0537 — numbered 1 through 6. The assessor records the same three stories and the same 1,479 square feet against every one of the six.
